    //==
    // # Builders
    //
    // Construction of the hierarchies above, in Plato, per
    // tracker/decisions/2026-08-04-spatial-structure-construction-in-plato.md.
    // These are reference bodies — correct and portable first (STYLE_GUIDE.md,
    // geometry priority); a backend recovers native speed through its override
    // table (plato-368). An explicit work stack replaces recursion, because
    // construction depth is a property of the data and bodies carry no
    // recursion contract; the stack is a List whose live height is tracked
    // beside it, so popped slots are reused rather than reallocated. The push
    // is inlined at each site (overwrite a dead slot when one exists, append
    // otherwise) rather than a List-receiver helper: backends install library
    // functions on their array types, not on the affine builders.

    // The union of the bounds named by one range of the permutation.
    // Precondition: start < end.
    RangeBounds(bounds: Array<Bounds3D>, perm: Buffer<Integer>, start: Integer, end: Integer): Bounds3D
    {
        var b = bounds[perm.At(start)];
        var i = start + 1;
        while (i < end)
        {
            b = b.Union(bounds[perm.At(i)]);
            i = i + 1;
        }
        return b;
    }

    // The coordinate of a point along a split axis: 0 is X, 1 is Y, 2 is Z.
    AxisCoordinate(p: Point3D, axis: Integer): Number
        => axis == 0 ? p.X : axis == 1 ? p.Y : p.Z;

    // The axis (0, 1, 2) along which the bounds extend furthest.
    WidestAxis(b: Bounds3D): Integer
    {
        var dx = b.Max.X - b.Min.X;
        var dy = b.Max.Y - b.Min.Y;
        var dz = b.Max.Z - b.Min.Z;
        return dx >= dy && dx >= dz ? 0 : (dy >= dz ? 1 : 2);
    }

    // Builds a binary BVH over primitive bounds by median split: each node
    // sorts its range of the permutation by centroid along the widest axis of
    // the centroid extents and splits at the middle, until a range fits
    // maxLeafSize (clamped to at least 1). Deterministic, and the split
    // recurses on strictly smaller non-empty ranges, so it terminates. The
    // permutation ends in leaf order, as the queries above require.
    BuildBvh(primitiveBounds: Array<Bounds3D>, maxLeafSize: Integer): Bvh3D
    {
        var n = primitiveBounds.Count;
        if (n == 0)
        {
            return (new List<BvhNode3D>().Freeze(), new List<ItemIndex>().Freeze());
        }
        var leafSize = maxLeafSize.Greater(1);
        var perm = new Buffer<Integer>(n);
        var i = 0;
        while (i < n)
        {
            perm = perm.Set(i, i);
            i = i + 1;
        }
        var placeholder = BvhNode3D(primitiveBounds[0],
            SpatialNodeIndex(-1), SpatialNodeIndex(-1), IntegerInterval(0, 0));
        var nodes = new List<BvhNode3D>().Add(placeholder);
        var stack = new List<IntegerVector3>().Add(IntegerVector3(0, 0, n));
        var top = 1;
        while (top > 0)
        {
            top = top - 1;
            var frame = stack.At(top);
            var node = frame.X;
            var start = frame.Y;
            var end = frame.Z;
            var nodeBounds = primitiveBounds.RangeBounds(perm, start, end);
            if (end - start <= leafSize)
            {
                nodes = nodes.Set(node, BvhNode3D(nodeBounds,
                    SpatialNodeIndex(-1), SpatialNodeIndex(-1), IntegerInterval(start, end)));
            }
            else
            {
                var count = end - start;
                var centroids = new Buffer<Point3D>(count);
                // The centroid extents accumulate through the Bounds3D-Bounds3D
                // Union rather than BoundsOfPoints: overloads that differ only
                // in the array element type collapse to one prototype slot in
                // the TypeScript backend, so bodies meant to run everywhere
                // avoid them.
                var firstCentroid = primitiveBounds[perm.At(start)].Center;
                var centroidBounds = Bounds3D(firstCentroid, firstCentroid);
                var j = 0;
                while (j < count)
                {
                    var centroid = primitiveBounds[perm.At(start + j)].Center;
                    centroids = centroids.Set(j, centroid);
                    centroidBounds = centroidBounds.Union(Bounds3D(centroid, centroid));
                    j = j + 1;
                }
                var centroidArray = centroids.Freeze();
                var axis = centroidBounds.WidestAxis;
                var order = centroidArray.SortedIndices((a, b) =>
                    a.AxisCoordinate(axis) <= b.AxisCoordinate(axis));
                var reordered = new Buffer<Integer>(count);
                j = 0;
                while (j < count)
                {
                    reordered = reordered.Set(j, perm.At(start + order[j]));
                    j = j + 1;
                }
                j = 0;
                while (j < count)
                {
                    perm = perm.Set(start + j, reordered.At(j));
                    j = j + 1;
                }
                var mid = start + count / 2;
                var left = nodes.Count;
                nodes = nodes.Add(placeholder).Add(placeholder);
                nodes = nodes.Set(node, BvhNode3D(nodeBounds,
                    SpatialNodeIndex(left), SpatialNodeIndex(left + 1), IntegerInterval(start, start)));
                stack = top < stack.Count
                    ? stack.Set(top, IntegerVector3(left, start, mid))
                    : stack.Add(IntegerVector3(left, start, mid));
                top = top + 1;
                stack = top < stack.Count
                    ? stack.Set(top, IntegerVector3(left + 1, mid, end))
                    : stack.Add(IntegerVector3(left + 1, mid, end));
                top = top + 1;
            }
        }
        return (nodes.Freeze(), perm.Freeze().Map(v => ItemIndex(v)));
    }

    // The octant of `p` around `center`, X varying fastest as the node types
    // require: bit 0 set when p.X >= center.X, bit 1 for Y, bit 2 for Z.
    OctantOf(p: Point3D, center: Point3D): Integer
        => (p.X >= center.X ? 1 : 0) + (p.Y >= center.Y ? 2 : 0) + (p.Z >= center.Z ? 4 : 0);

    // The o-th octant of a bounds, X varying fastest: bit 0 picks the +X
    // half, bit 1 the +Y half, bit 2 the +Z half.
    OctantBounds(b: Bounds3D, o: Integer): Bounds3D
    {
        var c = b.Center;
        var highX = o % 2 == 1;
        var highY = o / 2 % 2 == 1;
        var highZ = o / 4 == 1;
        return (Point3D(highX ? c.X : b.Min.X, highY ? c.Y : b.Min.Y, highZ ? c.Z : b.Min.Z),
                Point3D(highX ? b.Max.X : c.X, highY ? b.Max.Y : c.Y, highZ ? b.Max.Z : c.Z));
    }
